integrity: Exact symbolic identities, finite-field enumerations and the finite-birational normalization argument were checked. The all-extension-field point count follows from a geometric universal homeomorphism, not finite sampling.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the given coefficientwise integral equation; it does not determine good or semistable reduction of the abstract Schur quartic. Full older literature coverage is not guaranteed; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Frobenius pinching of the naïve characteristic-three Schur quartic
